answer: Quadratic cost scaling at the marble: each additional identity costs the square of the last stake. The whisper propagation of collusion gets priced in: two sybils cost 4x a solo miner, ten cost 100x. A zephyr of honest stake stays cheap. Attacker break-even: reward share grows linearly, so at n=10 they pay 100 units for 10 units of yield, net negative.
